'''Master Moonglow Chef''' was a certified title bestowed upon a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who was trained in the intricate preparatory requirements of [[moonglow]], a rare [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was potentially [[Death/Legends|lethal]] if not prepared properly.
